programme.desc: S04 E06 — Killian The zombie team has little time for an additional flip, and they don't have the cash on hand; When a good deal appears, the team decides it could be worth it if they can work fast and limit their loan interest to a single one-month payment.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S04 E14 — Amherst A large corner lot is home to an ugly house that the previous owners left full of half-baked, shoddy renovations, including a master bath that opens into the hallway and a bedroom as red as the gates of hell.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S05 E10 — Orlando: Sweetbriar The team is back at the Jewel Oaks neighborhood in Orlando, Fla., where Duke and Keith first flipped a house together.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S04 E08 — Orangewood The team leaves its comfort zone with a six-bed-six-bath new construction that was abandoned after framing; it's not a typical zombie, but this flip has the potential to take in several hundred grand.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S02 E04 — The Frankenzombie The team stumbles across a zombie house with two front doors, and they know that this will be a flip unlike any other; they have their work cut out for them turning the Frankenzombie into a cohesive home.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S06 E16 — Tampa: Peppertree When Dolmar and the team get a deal on a 4 bedroom two bath from one of Dolmar's lender contacts in the suburb of Port Richey, it seems too good to be true; when the market shifts, it's causing Dolmar and his team to have to make a hard decision.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S06 E01 — Dallas: Arcadia Derek and Chauncey take on a zombie house abandoned by previous flippers; with holes in the roof, termite damage, and a dilapidated porch, this nightmare house pushes their skills and budget to the limit.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S04 E06 — Killian The zombie team has little time for an additional flip, and they don't have the cash on hand; When a good deal appears, the team decides it could be worth it if they can work fast and limit their loan interest to a single one-month payment.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S05 E24 — Orlando: Old Mill This lakefront neighborhood zombie seems like a great deal, with its massive swimming pool, vintage original floors, plus the potential to bring in a six-figure profit.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S03 E07 — The Animal House The team finds a rundown house on a prime lakefront lot with the potential for a nice six-figure payday, but the decaying home has become a haven for wild critters that threaten to throw the flip for a loop.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S05 E12 — Tampa: Spring Hill The team sets their sights on expanding outside of Tampa in an effort to outwit the difficult housing market; Sam proposes doing a quick 30-day flip on a house she's been hired to sell, and the team jumps at the idea.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Blood, Sweetbriar, and Tears Keith talks his partners into going in with him on a zombie house flip located in a prime school district that he not only just purchased but that he already flipped five years ago.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S03 E04 — The Waterlogged Cabin A "lurker" zombie looks okay on the surface, but contains hidden water damage under its skin; fixing it up becomes a race against the weather, as frequent rains start to penetrate the house and destroy the upgrades mid-flip.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S06 E14 — Tampa: 58th Avenue The zombie team has their work cut out for them when they discover a 3bed/2bath might be missing a bedroom; termites, collapsing ceilings and some surprises might just be a budget-buster.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Breaking Banchory Ashlee convinces the team to let her take creative control of a flip, but arguments over design choices spark a showdown that slows the remodel and drives up the project's budget.
programme.title: Zombie House Flipping

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Hot Tub Flip Machine James Dainard and his team connect with Tyler, a first-time flipper with a lead on a zombie house they'll need to renovate from top to bottom; but entrusting such a big job to a newbie makes them question whether he can execute the plan on time.
programme.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Farmhouse Flipping Fiasco James Dainard and his team try to make the grade when they partner with Bre, an aspiring flipper, to revive a rundown farmhouse; with major issues, James doubts it's the right project for an inexperienced flipper, but Bre is determined.
programme.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Flipping the Mid-Century Mess James Dainard and his zombie house-flipping team take on new partners, Shannon and Christian, ambitious real estate developers, eager to make their mark in the flipping game.
programme.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips

programme.desc: S01 E04 — This Flippin' Guy James Dainard butts heads when the competition, fellow flipper Rob, brings him a potential project: a split-level property with a massive yard in a prime neighborhood; Rob's short on funds and full of confidence.
programme.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Sibling Flip Out Expert house flipper James Dainard and his team partner with brother-sister newbie flippers Blake and Abby on a risky zombie house project; James funds the renovation, while the siblings manage the contractors and oversee the work.
programme.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Pool House Clusterflip A massive zombie home with a terrible layout and a rotting pool house in the backyard; Andy's stubbornness becomes a problem; James struggles to decide if Andy's attitude and the challenging pool house will make or break the deal.
programme.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Flipping the Fortress Ambitious flipper Leka finds a promising zombie house in Seattle but lacks the funds to make it happen; expert flipper James Dainard is intrigued yet skeptical due to the house's poor curb appeal and choppy layout.
programme.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips

programme.desc: S30 E21 — Kentwell Hall Riding crop made from love letters; toys owned by a girl who inspired the illustrations for "Alice in Wonderland."
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S30 E22 — Leicester The team visit De Montfort Hall in Leicester, and things take a theatrical turn; items include some antique TV footage and a poster that turns out to be a painting worth thousands.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S30 E23 — Ulverston The Coronation Hall in Ulverston.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S30 E24 — Bexhill-on-Sea The Antiques Roadshow teams up with an iconic modernist building, the De La Warr Pavilion at Bexhill-on-Sea, to identify items from the recent past that should be cherished for the future.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S30 E25 — Sheffield Items at Sheffield City Hall include an abstract sculpture, an old master painting, and letters written by Mary Queen of Scots.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S30 E27 — Farewell Michael Michael Aspel looks back on the 200 episodes he has hosted, meeting up with specialists and updating some of the objects featured during his eight years with the series.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S31 E01 — Bolton Abbey Fiona Bruce takes over as presenter as the team visit Bolton Abbey.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S31 E02 Items under scrutiny include a writing desk, a Civil War sword and an important painting.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S31 E03 — Chester Cathedral Small and valuable pieces of furniture; Elvis memorabilia; jewels sown into a dress and smuggled out of pre-Revolution Russia.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S31 E04 — Ascot Copying machine; small coin; model of a champion racehorse.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S31 E05 — Althorp & Ascot An early English tapestry; modern paintings; documents record the rescue of a Russian royal family aboard a British battleship.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S31 E06 — Lanhydrock Bruce and the team set up in the grounds of Lanhydrock, near Bodmin in Cornwall.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S31 E07 — Southwell 1 A 17th-century love token of a betrothal box; haul of silver; original speaking clock.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S31 E08 — Southwell 2 An old toy train; pocket watch; romantic painting.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Bangladesh Curry is at the top of Rick's list as he ends his culinary tour in Bangladesh.
programme.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey

programme.desc: S01 E01 — The Great British Barbie The series kicks off with a complete guide to cooking on coals, from lighting the fire to the barbecue essentials; Ainsley also tests different types of barbecues.
programme.title: Ainsley's Barbecue Bible

programme.desc: S01 E01 — The Great British Barbie The series kicks off with a complete guide to cooking on coals, from lighting the fire to the barbecue essentials; Ainsley also tests different types of barbecues.
programme.title: Ainsley's Barbecue Bible

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Greece Visiting the Greek Island of Alonnisos to sample traditional barbecue consisting of spit-roasted lamb and hortopita.
programme.title: Ainsley's Barbecue Bible

programme.desc: S01 E03 — South Africa Visiting South Africa to find unusual recipes for cooking over coals.
programme.title: Ainsley's Barbecue Bible

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Thailand Visiting Thailand to sample a unique recipe for fish and chips and a barbecue cornucopia.
programme.title: Ainsley's Barbecue Bible

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Jamaica The history of Jamaican barbecue recipes from the Arawaks over 1,200 years ago.
programme.title: Ainsley's Barbecue Bible

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Australia Sampling the cuisine of Australia.
programme.title: Ainsley's Barbecue Bible

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.
programme.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes

programme.desc: S01 E02 On a misty lagoon in Sardinia Rick watches the fishermen catch mullet using the same methods as the Romans did centuries before. He boards a ferry for Sicily to find, in the heart of Palermo, one of the best pasta dishes he's ever tasted.
programme.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.
programme.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.
programme.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.
programme.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.
programme.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Fashion Rachel celebrates the quirkiness and individuality of London fashion in her kitchen, proving it's more about creativity than the price tag when it comes to getting your food looking and tasting good.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Crowd Pleasers Rachel makes some simple colorful canapés that are perfect for a party and creates a sophisticated jelly for grown-ups.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Nostalgia London makes Rachel feel nostalgic about her childhood, so she visits an ice-cream lab in North London and makes a firm family favorite - Strudel.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Fast Food Rachel explores London's fast food scene, and whips up berry tartlets with cream cheese frosting and cauliflower cheeseburgers.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Lazy Days Rachel prepares her favourite food for the perfect lazy day, cycles along a canal, visits her friend Tom's urban garden, and whips up a shepherdless pie.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London

programme.desc: S01 E06 — East Meets West Rachel celebrates London's love with the East as she makes sticky chicken with Malaysian salad and soft steamed buns.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Traditional Values Rachel celebrates Londoners' love of tradition as she puts her own twist on the traditional fry-up and makes a simple one-tray roast.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London

programme.desc: S01 E08 — On The Move Rachel joins an unusual supper club on an old tube carriage and makes sausage and mash for taxi drivers.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London

programme.desc: S01 E09 — DIY Rachel visits a basement Norwegian style salmon smokehouse and a shop where the shelves are stocked with preserves made on a hob at home.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London

programme.desc: S01 E10 — The Pleasure's All Mine Rachel goes for a decadent champagne afternoon tea in Mayfair and makes some finger-licking ribs.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Bordeaux Heading to autumnal Bordeaux; Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest; he hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast that is abundant with mussels and oysters.
programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.
programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Berlin Rick enjoys a long weekend in Berlin, where history and the Avant-garde dwell side by side; a city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an array of innovative chefs offering seasonal creations like puréed sunflower seeds.
programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Vienna Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to dishes like tafelspitz and goulash; Vienna gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the wiener schnitzel.
programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends

programme.desc: S01 E01 Rachel explores Melbourne's Chinatown, tastes some of the cities infamous coffee and checks out the new type of restaurant taking over Australia's food-loving capital.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne

programme.desc: S01 E02 Rachel pays a visit to a century-old milk bar and a bar serving up some twists on Aussie classics before meeting up with Kate Gibbs, the granddaughter of legendary Aussie cook Margaret Fulton.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne

programme.desc: S01 E03 Rachel explores some of the city's outer edges, where she discovers authentic and tasty croissants, before meeting up with seasonal cooking advocate Matt Wilkinson.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne

programme.desc: S01 E04 Rachel takes a trip to the Bellarine Peninsula, an up-and-coming foodies' paradise, where she meets up with a mussel trawler, winery owner and cheese maker.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne

programme.desc: S01 E05 Rachel shines a spotlight on Melbourne's sport fanatics' favorite gourmet fast food and cooks up a storm with the city's original food truck proprietor.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne

programme.desc: S01 E06 Keen to explore this melting pot of cuisines, Rachel explores a Vietnamese food market, tracks down a suburban hot bed of Greek eats, and learns how to make passata from an Italian-Australian nonna.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne

programme.desc: S01 E07 Rachel explores one of the lesser-known regions on Melbourne's doorstep, the Dandenongs, where she meets up with Argentinian chef Mauro Callegari.
programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne

programme.desc: S01 E08 On her last few days in Melbourne, Rachel takes a look at the city's current and future food trends and throws a barbecue party for the foodies she has met during her time in Australia.

programme.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets

programme.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral

programme.desc: S02 E13 — Heavy Metals A James Bond submarine car stored in a locker, rock guitars with historical roots and locomotives resting on the ocean floor demonstrate how heavy metal artifacts preserve historical events.
programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo

programme.desc: S02 E03 — Shady Secrets Some secrets refuse to stay buried; whether it's illicit cargo in a frozen lake, a stolen masterpiece worth millions, or a brothel hidden in the shadow of the Capitol-the truth always resurfaces.
programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Beastly Revelations From a mythical monster that turns out to be real, to a deadly prehistoric animal, and a frozen tundra hiding a pandora's box full of lethal pathogens, these startling discoveries shock and terrify the world.
programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo

programme.desc: S02 E18 — Grave Secrets From a hidden cache of bones, to an ancient tomb shrouded in mystery and even a rare sports car dug up in a backyard; these eerie revelations prove that some secrets refuse to stay buried.
programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo

programme.desc: S02 E05 — Famous Finds A forgotten manuscript in a dusty trunk; a priceless painting discovered in plain sight; a royal tomb hidden for millennia beneath the sands; these famous finds prove history's greatest treasures often resurface when least expected.
programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Hidden Giants From a legendary city swallowed by the jungle, to an underground metropolis stretching 18 levels deep, and even a forgotten pyramid from a lost civilization, sometimes the biggest mysteries on Earth are closer than we think.
programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo

programme.desc: S02 E16 — Powerful Discoveries From Mussolini's hidden bunker, to a warship built to dominate, and coins bearing Henry VIII's authority, these discoveries reveal how power leaves its mark long after its rulers are gone.
programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo

programme.desc: S02 E08 — Secrets From the Skies A long-lost keepsake tied to the world's most famous astronaut, a giant flying reptile that once ruled the skies, and a previously unknown planet orbiting two suns; some extraordinary discoveries remind us to keep looking up.
programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Blasts From the Past World War II bombs pulled from the sea and Nazi bunkers buried in sand.
programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo

programme.title: Art of Murder

programme.title: Her Last Patient

programme.desc: A couple banks on getting married without meeting in person, only for the wedding to devolve into chaos.
programme.title: It's Complicated AF

programme.desc: When a tragedy upends his thriving operation, high-level drug dealer Meeko pivots into the blackmail business with his sister. Their new venture proves highly profitable, but draws dangerous outcomes.
programme.title: Receipts

programme.desc: Xavier and his wife Amanda, take their daughter on a road trip hoping for a family reset. After a pit stop, Amanda and Alexandria disappear, and everyone is convinced he came to the park alone.
programme.title: Widower Syndrome

programme.title: The Special Affect

programme.desc: An unknowingly selfish mechanic, unable to save his failing business, agrees to take part in a four-man robbery. Now hiding out from the cops, he must survive the night in a room of people where he's not the most selfish.
programme.title: Tainted Waters

programme.title: Bottled Lust

programme.desc: Skylar, a professional seductress hired for divorce leverage, falls for her target. As their connection grows, she reveals the truth, angering his wife. A dangerous game ensues, with love and survival on the line.
programme.title: Mistress for Hire

programme.title: Bloodline of the Jewel

programme.title: If I Can't Have You

programme.title: Crash Out

programme.title: Teacher's Pet

programme.desc: A successful power couple is tested by betrayal and illegal activity. Both love and business face being destroyed.
programme.title: I Hate I Love You

programme.desc: Best of Rescue Knights When Duke and Claw use a magic cauldron to put the people of Barkingburg to sleep, their plan backfires when the enchanted fog works on Sparks; it's up to the PAW Patrol to wake up the Dragon along with everyone else in town.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S10 E24 — Pups Save a Runaway Robo-Chicken Purse; Pups Save the Buggy Trekkers Digi and Tal's inventions to help a busy Mayor Goodway go haywire and lead to a wild woodland chase; when Mayor Humdinger squeezes himself into the Trekkers' friendly dune buggy race, his cheating ways put the other racers in jeopardy.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S07 E15 — Pups Save the Marooned Mayors; Pups Save the Game Show While ice fishing in the North Country, Mayor Goodway and Mayor Humdinger get stuck in an ice crevasse; Beryl hosts a game show at the Wingnuts' farm.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Pups Save a Teeny Penguin; Pups Save the Cat Show Everest and Jake try to rescue a little penguin and end up floating out to sea on a homemade bridge; Katie's kittens are all covered in mud and running amuck, so the pups must round them up before the Cat Show is ruined.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S02 E08 — Pups and the Big Freeze; Pups Save a Basketball Game A winter ice storm causes trouble throughout Adventure Bay; Mayor Goodway challenges Mayor Humdinger's basketball team to a game.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S07 E24 — Moto Pup: Pups Save a Sneezy Chase; Moto Pups: Rescue at Twisty Top Mesa Moto Pups must rescue the baddies off the Twisty Top Mesa; Chase's cat allergies lead him to the desert, and he's trapped with the Ruff Ruff Pack.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S08 E21 — Dancing With Luke Stars; Pups Save a Mischievous Octopus A dance contest being judged by Luke Stars goes wrong when a floating dance floor carries the contestants away; the pups investigate a mystery at an undersea-themed museum exhibit and discover an octopus that wants to return to the ocean.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S08 E10 — Pups and Katie Stop the Barking Kitty Crew; Pups Save the Glasses Mayor Humdinger disrupts Adventure Bay with his barking kitties; Katie and the pups rescue the town; Cap'n Turbot loses his glasses.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S10 E17 — Mighty Pups Stop the Mighty Queen; Mighty Pups Stop the Hiccups The Mighty Pups must stop Sweetie from using her new powers to take over Adventure Bay; Mighty Nano gets the hiccups, so it's up to Liberty and the Mighty Pups to find a cure.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S11 E03 — Pups Plus a Plucky Chicken; Pups Save a Pet Show When Humdinger steals Farmer Al's super-powered seeds, Chickaletta joins the PAW Patrol to help stop the mayor's corny plan; when Humdinger steals Katie and Cali's tiaras, it's up to the pups to save their costumes and the pet show.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S02 E24 — Pups Save a Pizza; Pups Save Skye While delivering special pizza dough for a party, Alex and Mr. Porter get into an accident; a storm causes Skye to crash-land in the snow while on her way to Jake's Mountain.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S05 E07 — Genie in a Bubble! When Nonny, Gil and Zooli conjure a genie, she agrees to grant a wish to whoever brings her the most precious gift.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S05 E13 — Too Bright for Movie Night! If the Moon People can find a way to make it dark during the day, the Sun People agree to turn off their giant night light so the Moon People can enjoy their movie night.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S06 E10 — The Jaw-some Sharkventure! Zooli and her crew of marine biologists escort their new friends Baby Shark and his pilot fish, William, to visit Baby Shark's great-great-great-great-great Uncle Slow Mo and help them escape the determined fisherman who's chasing them.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S02 E10 — Milli Saves the Day Milli must save her friends when they get stuck in honey and scooped up by a bear.
programme.title: Team Umizoomi

programme.desc: S02 E18 — Umi Toy Store The team must search through a toy store for their friend's lost Umicents.
programme.title: Team Umizoomi

programme.desc: S03 E20 — Pups Get Skunked; Pups and a Whale of a Tale When Everest gets sprayed by a skunk, the pups tell her delicately that she needs a bath; the pups fly north to help free a baby whale that is trapped under the ice.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: Seth sees his best friend disappear in a flash of light. Two years later, Seth is still dealing with the fallout and suspicions when a series of grisly murders rocks the community.
programme.title: Almost Human

programme.desc: As Taiwan succumbs to a viral pandemic that transforms peaceful citizens into sadistic, bloodthirsty maniacs, a young couple must battle to be reunited before they too become infected.
programme.title: The Sadness

programme.desc: To determine what happened to some Russian hikers, five U.S. college students go back to where the hikers were found dead. The students don't return from the expedition, either, and the recovered footage is deemed too disturbing for public viewing.
programme.title: Devil's Pass

programme.desc: A young woman (Najarra Townsend) begins bleeding, shedding maggots and hallucinating after a stranger date rapes her at a party.
programme.title: Contracted

programme.desc: A timid actress, a tortured painter, a pretentious writer, a psychotic sculptor and a rock band all become entangled when their insecurities manifest themselves into monsters and ghouls.
programme.title: Allegoria

programme.desc: A young apprentice healer tries to suppress his supernatural abilities so he can fit in with the other kids, but when a malicious spirit breaks out in his apartment he decides to use his abilities while dark family secrets are revealed.
programme.title: Blood Flower

programme.desc: A stripper and a religious protester are trapped together in a peep show booth and must come together to survive the apocalypse.
programme.title: Revealer

programme.desc: Seven filmmakers present seven terrifying and comedic tales of horror.
programme.title: Scare Package

programme.desc: Intergalactic assassins converge on a small town after two siblings unwittingly resurrect an ancient alien overlord.
programme.title: PG: Psycho Goreman

programme.desc: The joyful spirit of Christmas takes one dark turn after another -- from sadistic office parties and last-minute shopping nightmares to vengeful stalkers and immortal demons.
programme.title: All the Creatures Were Stirring

programme.desc: A heartbroken man finds himself trapped in a bathroom with a strange voice who says he may be the only hope in stopping a terrible event.
programme.title: Glorious

programme.desc: A supernatural serial killer based on pre-Colombian mythology hunts for revenge in the metropolis of São Paulo.
programme.title: Skull: The Mask

programme.desc: Romain sees an injured woman and decides to help her, but when she gets in his car, she suddenly smashes her own head against the dashboard, bleeding out until she dies.
programme.title: MadS

programme.desc: Scientists discover that a red liquid leaking from a nearby glacier contains organisms that turn living hosts into deadly mutants.
programme.title: Blood Glacier

programme.desc: A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.
programme.title: The Hallow

programme.desc: In 1984 a Russian research team goes below the surface to find out what secret the world's deepest borehole is hiding. On their expedition, something unexpectedly gruesome awaits the researchers.
programme.title: Superdeep

programme.desc: While assigned to community duty, teenagers stumble upon a flesh-eating female ghoul and decide to capture her.
programme.title: Mon Mon Mon Monsters

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Gray Matter; The House of the Head A man's drinking habit becomes insatiable, and his appetite grows to frightening proportions; a severed toy head appears in a girl's dollhouse and starts murdering.
programme.title: Creepshow

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Bad Wolf Down; The Finger A platoon of American soldiers finds something more sinister than war behind enemy lines; a man with a passion for found objects finds a growing finger.
programme.title: Creepshow

programme.desc: S01 E03 — All Hallows Eve; The Man in the Suitcase Teens who go trick-or-treating are met with fear instead of smiles and sweets; Justin brings home the wrong suitcase and is shocked to find a living man stuffed inside.
programme.title: Creepshow

programme.desc: S01 E04 — The Companion; Lydia Layne's Better Half Harry stumbles upon an old scarecrow and accidentally brings it to life; Lydia kills her lover and needs to hide the evidence, but she gets trapped inside an elevator with the body.
programme.title: Creepshow

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Night of the Paw; Times Is Tough in Musky Holler A killer gets stranded in a funeral home with a mortician and his monkey paw; a former mayor and his followers who controlled a town through fear and intimidation get a taste of their own medicine.
programme.title: Creepshow

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Skincrawlers; By the Silver Water of Lake Champlain A doctor discovers a solution for weight loss; Rose believes she has found Champ, the legendary monster of Lake Champlain, but the real monster may still be out there.
programme.title: Creepshow

programme.desc: S02 E01 — Model Kid; Public Television of the Dead Joe's closest friends are the model toys of his favorite scary movie monsters; a public TV station is overwhelmed when the appraisal of an antique book summons a dark force.
programme.title: Creepshow

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Dead & Breakfast, Pesticide A marketing ploy at a haunted Bed and Breakfast becomes too realistic; an exterminator gets more than he bargained for when he takes on a big job.
programme.title: Creepshow

programme.desc: S02 E03 — The Right Snuff; Sibling Rivalry A misunderstanding in space ensures two astronauts go down in history for all the worst reasons; Lola is convinced her brother is trying to kill her, but she's worried about the wrong monster.
programme.title: Creepshow

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Pipe Screams; Within the Walls of Madness A complicated drain clog; scientists fight to contain the creature they've been studying.
programme.title: Creepshow

programme.desc: S02 E05 — Night of the Living Late Show Simon has invented an incredible virtual reality experience that allows him to join in on his favorite films but is unprepared for when virtual reality becomes his actual reality.
programme.title: Creepshow

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Mums; Queen Bee A boy mourns the loss of his mother; a couple of teens sneak into a hospital and end up getting a little more than they bargained for.

programme.title: Voices for Humanity

programme.desc: S01 E10 — What Is Scientology? One in a series of articles by L. Ron Hubbard, "What Is Scientology?" is a forthright essay on the very essence of the philosophy that gives rise to the worldwide religious movement and its necessity as a foundation for modern life.
programme.title: L. Ron Hubbard Library Presents

programme.desc: Chick Corea: In the Mind of a Master The world's greatest musicians and composers head into Mad Hatter Studios, the legendary recording studio in Los Angeles, to record their latest albums; witness the creative process, from writing to final recordings, as it unfolds before the cameras.

programme.desc: A lucrative association has developed between pharmaceutical manufacturers and the psychiatric profession.
programme.title: The Marketing of Madness: Are We All Insane?

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Fred Shaw Alarmed at the rate children were being labeled with a mental disorder as a pretext to be given psychotropic drugs or electroshock therapy, Fred Shaw's nationwide campaign raises awareness of the issue and calls for an end to the abuse.
programme.title: Voices for Humanity

programme.desc: A series of public service announcements raises awareness for all 30 of the fundamental human rights specifically guaranteed to every human being by the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.

programme.desc: Astrophysicists at the forefront of the search consider the possibility of finding a planet like Earth among any of the bodies discovered by a new space-based telescope.
programme.title: Planet Hunters

programme.desc: S5 E1 — Eye of Ida Witnessing Hurricane Ida's devastation as it reduces Louisiana to rubble; following a man running for his life from California wildfires; facing a deadly sea swirl with a Norwegian ship crew; looking for a snow kiter engulfed by an avalanche.
programme.title: World's Deadliest Weather

programme.desc: S5 E2 — Turkey Tsunami Rescuers aid a young girl trapped under rubble after a Turkish earthquake, all while a tsunami threatens to add to the turmoil; a father and daughter escape Oregon wildfires; a flash flood upstages an outdoor wedding.
programme.title: World's Deadliest Weather

programme.desc: S5 E3 — La Palma Volcano Molten lava devours homes and lives when a volcano erupts on La Palma; an entire U.S. town submerged by endless downpours; colossal ice boulders in Italy.
programme.title: World's Deadliest Weather

programme.desc: S5 E4 — Tornado Terror An Ontario man flings into a tornado; a helicopter and jet ski rescue team go into an intense flood; an avalanche crashes a party; an adventurer survives being trapped upside down in a raging river in Papua New Guinea.
programme.title: World's Deadliest Weather

programme.desc: The 2011 Super Tornado carved a mile wide path of destruction through Joplin, Missouri.
programme.title: SuperTornado: Anatomy of a Megadisaster

programme.title: Lake Geneva: The Giant Tsunami

programme.desc: Tsunamis are so sudden and powerful that in a matter of minutes, they can wipe out a coastline.
programme.title: Tsunami: Facing the Global Threat

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Why Our Forests Are Burning Up A group of experts studying the range and impact of megafires examine why these blazes are beyond control, what makes them insatiable and what is causing the crisis.
programme.title: Megafires: The Global Threat

programme.desc: S1 E2 — How to Survive on a Burning Planet A team of experts introduces both ancient and newly discovered fire prevention techniques that can help confront the era of megafires to protect homes and families.
programme.title: Megafires: The Global Threat

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Part 1 Floods are a growing threat to our planet, posing engineering and technological challenges.

programme.title: Floods - Challenging our Future

programme.desc: S4 E2 — Wall of Flames Wildfires rip through Victoria, Australia. In Texas, a skydiving training session ends in disaster when there's a major midair collision at 30,000 feet.
programme.title: World's Deadliest Weather

programme.desc: S01 E02 — It's Taco Time Tacos are the way to Chef Dale's heart, and he's grilling up a sweet and smoky lemongrass and guajillo pork with pineapple, served with coconut and cotija cheese corn and an avocado jicama salad.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Restaurant-Style Whole Roast Fish Chef Dale grills to impress with restaurant quality meal of whole roasted fish, coconut milk grits, and snow pea, watermelon and tamarind salad.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Vegetables, but Delicious Chef Dale crafts a family style platter of trumpet mushrooms, eggplant marinated in spicy ssam jang, and charred yellow squash served with a green goddess dressing.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E08 — Sunday Vietnamese Brisket with Noodles Chef Dale Talde shows us how he does Sunday up right as he grills up some Vietnamese Brisket with Rice Noodles, Crispy Swordfish Summer Rolls, and tops it all off with some tasty Soju Floats. Hey, it's Sunday somewhere, right?
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Beer Brats & BBQ Ribs Chef Dale Talde grills up summer favorites perfect for any backyard BBQ. Cheddar beer brats in a pretzel bun, BBQ lamb ribs with Chinese mustard sauce, watermelon lime soju punch, & warm donuts with grilled strawberries & whipped cream for dessert.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E11 — The Perfection of Pork Chef Dale Talde brings the heat when it comes to making perfect pork dishes including a root beer glazed pork banh mi, chorizo fried rice, Filipino sausage stuffed long hot peppers, and round it all out with a spicy grilled pineapple sundae.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E12 — Tempting Tasty Tacos It's always taco night at Chef Dale's house! He turns up the heat with grilled salmon tacos with salsa verde & cauliflower escabeche, duck al pastor tacos with habanero pineapple salsa, & a smoky mushroom queso taco with truffle mole negro.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E04 — Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S04 E06 — Grilled Loco Moco and Huli Huli Chicken The options are plentiful when Chef Dale smothers grilled Loco Moco with a mushroom gravy, salty and sweet Huli Huli Chicken with charred pineapple, and healthy scoops of Tuna Water Chestnut poke or mac salad.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S04 E05 — World of Burgers! It's burger day! Chef Dale tackles three classics with a full flavor spin. Game changing Pho Burgers with bone marrow, toasted milk bread Ahi Tuna patty melts, and Chori Pan Burgers with a fried egg and shrimp chips.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S04 E07 — Street Eats off the Grill Japan, Thailand, Turkey, and Mexico street foods inspire Dale to grill with dynamically preparing Chili-Cuman Lamb Mushroom sticks, Grilled pork and shrimp shumai, and scallion pancakes with brown butter labneh.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S04 E08 — Sizzlin' Summer Fruits Summer seasonal fruit pampers your taste buds. Chef Dale grills blistered grapes with ham wrapped trout, peaches with smoked pork chops, watermelon with halloumi, and char-grilled cherries with chocolate mousse.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E13 — Heavenly Hibachi Bites Chef Dale Talde tries his hand at hibachi by making supreme fried rice with shrimp, chicken, and bacon, pretzel pork dumplings, mushroom noodles, a filet of beef with the famous onion volcano, and washes it down with a melon & mint sake slushy.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E14 — Family-Friendly BBQ Chef Dale Talde creates a tasty menu that kids & parents alike will love! Apple pancakes with coconut brown butter syrup, grilled cheese & tomato soup, cheesy chicken parm, and a sticky s'mores dessert round out the full day of deliciousness.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E15 — Pizzapalooza Chef Dale Talde grills a Chicago-style pie, pepperoni pizza pocket, chicken wings, and a zesty grilled Caesar.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S07 E05 — Venison Satay & Classic Venison Wellington Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S07 E02 — Cajun-Style Grilled Wild Turkey & Creamy Tetrazzini Andrew gives holiday turkey the Wild Game Kitchen treatment with grilled turkey tetrazzini and a butter basted Cajun-spiced whole bird roasted over crawfish, andouille and cornbread stuffing.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E02 — Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E04 — Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E01 — Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E03 — Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E09 — Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Easy Pantry Staple Fish Cakes Jamie shares a simple salmon dish perfect for a midweek meal, and some no-fuss fish cakes made from tins. He cooks a lamb Madras traybake, as well as a no-cook pasta sauce, and crowns it all off with a hot and crispy ice cream parcel!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Smash Burger and Creamy Chicken with Mushrooms Jamie cooks a midweek meal of speedy sweet pea chicken, a juicy Smash burger and a chicken and mushroom rice traybake. He batch-cooks his seven-veg sauce, followed by a spicy fish soup. And finishes off with a perfect pudding of tinned fruit granita.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Jarred Pepper Pasta and Sheet Pan Brisket Jamie cooks a speedy jarred-pepper pasta, crispy chicken in baked-bread sauce, and a beef brisket tray bake - all prepped in minutes. He makes shelf-raid spiced haricot beans, and rounds it all off with a fast and simple strawberry & balsamic tart.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Creamy Chicken Pot Pie and Chocolate Tiramisu Jamie cooks a midweek traybake of roast veg and Camembert. He turns poached chicken into a creamy chicken & chive pie, serves up his easy green chilli salsa under sizzling butterflied prawns, and finishes it all off with decadent chocolate tiramisù.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Traditional Greek Cuisine Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Inspirational Spanish Tapas Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Making Couscous in Tunisia Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Traditional Greek Cuisine Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Stunning Seafood of Marseille Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Thanksgiving Spatchcock & Sides Frankie skips the stress and roasts a juicy spatchcocked turkey, then goes big on sides-cardamom rolls, Sweet & Savory Dauphinoise Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts with Bacon Jam, and a bright Citrus Salad with smoked salt.
programme.title: Let Frankie Cook

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Frankie's Feast of the Seven Fishes Frankie reimagines the Feast of the Seven Fishes with a shellfish-free spread making Smoked Whitefish Salad, Anchovy Butter Toast, Salt-baked Red Snapper, Trout Scapece, and Pasta con le Sarde, with a helping hand from his mom.
programme.title: Let Frankie Cook

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Getting the Band Back Together Frankie reunites his old band for a jam session and a spin on a college-era classic - featuring Shoyu Ramen with Tare Eggs, sweet and savory Chicken Meatballs, Seaweed Cucumber Salad, and a crispy Okonomiyaki pancake.
programme.title: Let Frankie Cook

programme.title: Let Frankie Cook

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Pancake Stacks and Snacks for Two Frankie flips the script for his wife Heather making breakfast for dinner featuring Banana Maple Pancakes, Eggs Benedict with prosciutto cotto, Home Fries with Bloody Mary Ketchup, Sausage Scrapple, and a boozy Espresso Milkshake.
programme.title: Let Frankie Cook

programme.desc: S01 E01 — The Wonderful World of Pizza Frankie makes pizza magic with two incredible doughs, turning his kitchen into a pizza party with grilled sausage pizza, cheesy Grandma Pies, golden Panzerotti, and a sweet dessert pizza topped with ricotta, berries, and honey.
programme.title: Let Frankie Cook

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Italian Smokehouse Frankie fires up a steakhouse-style spread with Italian flair from golden beets and buttery mushrooms to a sizzling Bistecca alla Fiorentina steak with salmoriglio sauce, and a smooth cold brew affogato granita.
programme.title: Let Frankie Cook

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Lunch That Goes the Distance Frankie fuels up for action making hot Oatmeal, and Energy Date Balls, before he cooks up the perfect post-ride feast of cheesy Juicy Lucy Burgers, Ramp-loaded pasta salad, and a maple ginger switchel to cool it all down.
programme.title: Let Frankie Cook

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Pasta From Scratch Frankie explores his Italian roots, pairing each pasta shape with its perfect sauce-from Cavatelli with Super Green Sauce to Pappardelle in pork ragout, ricotta Gnocchi with punchy anchovy pecorino, and cozy Squash Orzotto with bloomed poppy seeds.
programme.title: Let Frankie Cook

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S01 E01 — The Wonderful World of Pizza Frankie makes pizza magic with two incredible doughs, turning his kitchen into a pizza party with grilled sausage pizza, cheesy Grandma Pies, golden Panzerotti, and a sweet dessert pizza topped with ricotta, berries, and honey.

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Lunch That Goes the Distance Frankie fuels up for action making hot Oatmeal, and Energy Date Balls, before he cooks up the perfect post-ride feast of cheesy Juicy Lucy Burgers, Ramp-loaded pasta salad, and a maple ginger switchel to cool it all down.

programme.title: Let Frankie Cook

programme.title: Let Frankie Cook

programme.title: Let Frankie Cook

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Crispy Pork Noodles and Cheesy Chard Cannelloni Jamie celebrates rhubarb in a lip-smacking sauce, heroes spinach in a silky goat's cheese risotto and marries vibrant basil with chard in a crowd-pleasing cheesy spring cannelloni.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Spring Onion Chicken Curry and Sausage Broccoli Pizza Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Stuffed Salmon Celebration and Almond Custard Tart Jamie snazzes up some spuds with wild garlic pesto, creates a broad bean mezze, rustles up a beautiful spring salad and honours rhubarb in a luscious custard tart with almond brittle.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Jamie's ULTIMATE Autumn Garden FEAST! Jamie kicks off autumn with Italian-inspired cheesy cabbage pasta and smoky sweetcorn burgers with feta. He shares tips for storing onions and saving tomato seeds, finishing with a beautiful tomato galette for a perfect fall meal.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E10 — Jamie Makes the World's Best Christmas Lasagne Jamie throws the most festive Christmas Party! The menu includes cheesy filo parcels, a make-ahead Christmas cauliflower lasagne, and jerk-rubbed hasselback root veg with chicken kebabs. He finishes with a fudgy sticky toffee coffee pudding.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E11 — Jamie's Show-Stopping Christmas Porchetta Jamie welcomes his family to his outdoor shed for Christmas dinner! He swaps turkey for a show-stopping festive porchetta, served with crispy roast potatoes. The menu also includes a veggie Brussels sprouts pie and a mulled wine pear pavlova.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S07 E02 — Cajun-Style Grilled Wild Turkey & Creamy Tetrazzini Andrew gives holiday turkey the Wild Game Kitchen treatment with grilled turkey tetrazzini and a butter basted Cajun-spiced whole bird roasted over crawfish, andouille and cornbread stuffing.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E03 — A Whole Roasted Hog For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E01 — Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Best of Salina's Land and Sea Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Stunning Seafood of Marseille Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Making Couscous in Tunisia Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Inspirational Spanish Tapas Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Go Greek! Clash of the Titans The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.
programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip

programme.desc: S03 E03 — Desperately Seeking Santa Gordon, Gino and Fred are getting together for another extraordinary culinary Christmas adventure. Gordon arranged a trip to the official home of Santa. They are going to Lapland to enjoy spectacular landscapes and meet Father Christmas in person.
programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip

programme.desc: S02 E01 — The Three Amigos On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.
programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip

programme.desc: S02 E02 — What Happens in Vegas Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west.
programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip

programme.desc: S02 E03 — San Fran Summer of Love Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon.
programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Brokeback Mountain After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.
programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world.
programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip

programme.desc: S10 E05 — Jalisco Style Birria Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E02 — Food Meets Art Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E03 — Jalisco Classics In Guadalajara, Pati learns the secrets to menudo and birria. In her kitchen, Pati perfects her own recipes for a few Jalisco favorites: menudo, tepache, and jericalla.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E03 — The Best Tacos In Mérida Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E08 — The Heart of Tequila Pati visits the birthplace of Mexico's most famous spirit, the town of Tequila. Back home Pati makes a brunch of corn tortilla egg nests with salsa verde con chile de árbol and traditional arroz rojo.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E09 — A Day With Hugo Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E08 — Mayan Gateway To The Underworld No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E08 — Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E10 — Tacos and a Tostada Pati celebrates everyone's favorite Mexican creation, the taco. In her kitchen, Pati creates a pair of Jalisco-inspired tacos and a Ceviche tostada that are sure to satisfy any true taco-lover.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E09 — Double Vallarta Pati is in one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations - Puerto Vallarta. She gets an insider's tour of the best street food from one of the town's most acclaimed chefs, Thierry Boulet.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E05 — Jalisco Style Birria Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E02 — Food Meets Art Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E03 — Jalisco Classics In Guadalajara, Pati learns the secrets to menudo and birria. In her kitchen, Pati perfects her own recipes for a few Jalisco favorites: menudo, tepache, and jericalla.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E03 — The Best Tacos In Mérida Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E06 — Tradition and Innovation Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E03 — The World Cup of Tacos Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E07 — The Famous Pastes of Spices Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E10 — Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E01 — The Nectar of the Mayan Gods Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E04 — Bread Masters Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E05 — The Magic of Piloncillo The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E06 — Pioneering From Farm to Table Gaby Molinar owns Huerto Urbano, an urban farm dedicated to providing Monterrey with nutritious, diverse local ingredients. And her husband is one of the region's greatest culinary pioneers.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S06 E03 — Tracks and Tranquility Levi travels the countryside to see two historic railcars transformed into stationary sanctuaries; first, he arrives in Deary, Idaho, to step inside a restored 1909 carriage; next, Levi heads to Long Lane, Missouri, to tour a 1928 Luxury Railcar.
programme.title: Tiny BNB

programme.desc: S06 E05 — Peaks of Ringgold Levi travels to Ringgold, Georgia, to experience two towering stays; first, he scales the Selah Ridge Watchtower, a 35-foot-tall sanctuary; just a short hike away is the Selah Ridge Treehouse, a B&B that takes the tiny stay concept to new heights.
programme.title: Tiny BNB

programme.desc: Cleaned Up Kitchen Chaos & Clutter Busted Closet For Charmaine and Cameron's growing family, the kitchen has become the center of chaos; in a few simple steps, Brandie and Ryan edit, decant and transform their kitchen into a haven of organization.
programme.title: Sort It Out

programme.desc: Bathroom Revamp & Laundry Room Hack The Home Sort sisters transform spaces from chaos to clutter-free, in this case focusing on bathroom and laundry room revamps.
programme.title: Sort It Out

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Rust, Relics and Relaxation Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.
programme.title: Woodward Throwbacks

programme.desc: S01 E04 — The Reclaimed Kitchen Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. programme.title: Street Magic
programme.desc: Blink and you'll miss it. It's a cliche that holds true in many magic tricks, which often have the magical part of the illusion happen in a split second, which is how this show got its name. "Don't Blink" features street magicians performing their acts for onlookers, some of whom are celebrities. The sleight-of-hand artists, who have perfected their craft for years, show off their best illusions at locations around the world. The featured illusionists include Ed Alonzo -- perhaps best known as Max from "Saved by the Bell" -- and Johnny Ace Palmer.

programme.title: Live PD
programme.desc: Emmy-winning documentary series like "Intervention" and "Born This Way" illustrate A&E Network's commitment to provocative, culturally relevant programming. Fitting perfectly alongside such projects is "Live PD," which shines a light on the hot-button issue of policing in America by presenting a transparent look at law enforcement on duty. Incorporating dash cams along with fixed rig and handheld cameras, the series captures the work of a mix of urban and rural police forces on a typical Friday night. As host, veteran journalist Dan Abrams gives insight into what viewers are seeing in real time.

programme.title: Live PD
programme.desc: Emmy-winning documentary series like "Intervention" and "Born This Way" illustrate A&E Network's commitment to provocative, culturally relevant programming. Fitting perfectly alongside such projects is "Live PD," which shines a light on the hot-button issue of policing in America by presenting a transparent look at law enforcement on duty. programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Pantheon

programme.title: Pantheon

programme.title: Shirobako

programme.title: Shirobako

programme.title: Shirobako

programme.title: Shirobako

programme.title: Shirobako
programme.desc: Aoi cracks under the pressure of Erika's return and asks her to take over; Erika visits the Taitanic office to sort things out.

programme.title: Shirobako
programme.desc: Hiraoka implies that Midori is getting writing projects because she's a girl and argues with the director.

programme.title: Shirobako

programme.title: Shirobako
