programme.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy - SNAFU
programme.sub-title: Youth Romantic Comedy is Wrong, as I Expected
programme.desc: A loner is tricked into joining the "Services Club" and must help students with their problems.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Maine Dil Tujhko Diya
programme.desc: College stud and a famed band player Ajay is introduced to the stunning daughter of a business tycoon named Ayesha. Ajay is smitten by Ayesha's modesty and coyness and what starts off as a mere acquaintance soon turns into full-blown love affair. But Ayesha's father Mr. Verma is unhappy with their union and his associate Mr. Chopra takes advantage of his discontentment. Mr. Chopra, wanting to take over Mr. Verma's fortune, suggests his own son for Ayesha and brainwashes him about Ajay. The situation takes a deadly turn when a hit-man is appointed to end Ajay's life. But seeing Ajay's aggressive stubbornness to be with Ayesha, Mr. Verma gives him a challenge, to find his lady-love within a day or leave from her life forever. Ajay accepts the challenge, unaware that a bigger conspiracy is at work to tear them apart once and for all.

Valentina sorprende a Epi vestido de mujer y le cuenta a Gloria la historia de la niña que llevó en su vientre. Seis Nueve le confiesa a Julieta que cada vez se siente más atraído hacia ella. Julieta llama a sus padres, pero solo los escucha y no contesta. Zuleica le hace saber a Julieta que Seis Nueve es suyo y está decide irse del barrio. Ana Belén no entiende la actitud pasiva de su esposo con Valentina. Efraín no se anima a confesarle a su mujer, que está enamorado y que quiere dejarla. Deibis está muy desconforme con que Gabriel sea su tío. Toño le confiesa que a él tampoco le cae bien.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena no quiere seguir teniendo contacto con Gabriel, ya que esto afecta emocionalmente a su hijo Rodrigo. Es por esto que le devuelve una camiseta que León le había regalado al nene. Magdalena se dirige al hotel donde Agustín se está quedando y lo encuentra con una amante. Nayarí no quiere que su hijo siga teniendo contacto con Gabriel, por lo que le pide que los deje tranquilos. Casualmente Gabriel se encuentra con Deibis por la calle y quiere hablar con él. Efraín quiere tener un encuentro con Valentina, pero un llamado telefónico los interrumpe. Es Julieta, que necesita hablar con Valentina de todo lo que le pasó. Efraín se vuelve a su casa y quiere decirle a Ana Belén que quiere el divorcio, cuando Ricardo toca el timbre, preocupado por el paradero de Julieta.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Sofía logra lo que tanto ha planeado. Magdalena encuentra a Agustín en un hotel con una chica, quien ella sospecha que es la amante de su marido. Esto desata un gran problema en su matrimonio, tanto que ella decide pedirle el divorcio. Gabriel le cambia a Deibis su camioneta por la moto. Sin embargo, no fue algo muy bueno ya que dos ladrones secuestran a Deibis y a Angie debido al lujo que muestra la camioneta. Ana belén y Efraín están muy preocupados porque Julieta se ha ido de la casa. Es por eso que deciden pedirle ayuda a Ricardo, su jefe en La Deslenguada, porque en algún momento ella tendrá que comunicarse con él.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín decide darle el divorcio a Magdalena, y la tenencia de Rodrigo, pero a cambio de eso quiere quedarse con la galería de arte. Ésta fue la herencia del padre de Magdalena para ella, por lo que tiene mucho valor en su vida. Gabriel León encontró a Julieta, y planea acercarse a ella. Sus últimos estudios médicos no tuvieron un diagnóstico favorable, y no le queda mucho tiempo. Julieta está a punto de enterarse de la verdad, de parte de Valentina, pero su madre, Ana Belén llega a casa de Valentina. Anteriormente no quiso escuchar a su papá, Efraín. Nayarí se encuentra preparando los carnavales. Antonio consiguió trabajo junto a Agustín, en la galería de arte. Ambos creen que tendrán una buena relación, ya que a ninguno de ellos les cae bien Gabriel León.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal se reconcilia con Ana y ponen otra vez fecha de boda. Carlota va a visitar a Conrado y de paso le da una mano a Mireya con el aseo personal del enfermo. Pedrote llama a Patricia para que presencie en vivo y en directo como atrapan a unos ladrones en la joyería del centro comercial. Es allí donde se cruzan María José y Venancio por primera vez y ella queda impactada por el comisario. Purita ayuda a su madre en la limpieza del condominio pero se viste muy sexy y es regañada por su madre para que sea más discreta con la ropa que usa.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Guillermo y Ana deciden, a pesar de ellos, ser amigos para no interferir en la relación de ella con Cristóbal. Venancio le tiene que pedir disculpas a Pedro (Onofre) por acusarlo de la muerte de Diego ya que el comisario no tiene pruebas suficientes. Esto gratifica a Pedro pero al leer un primera plana que acusan al fantasma de la muerte del envenenado del rio, lo enfurece y promete matar a Barrranco por publicarlo, a Clarita y a Patricia por escribir esa nota. A su vez esa nota enorgullece a Nancy porque la escribió su hija, pero esto le trae problemas a Patricia con Pedrote porque él le dio esa información.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Marilda y Guillermo hablan sobre el engaño de Cristóbal. Barranco interviene en una discusión entre Pedrote y Patricia, Pedrote lo acusa de ser el culpable de que el Fantasma esté libre. Marilda le hace saber a Guillermo que podría contarle a Ana el engaño de Cristóbal con ella. Nancy está visitando a su padre, Conrado; su esposa, Mireya le dice que contratará a Carlota como enfermera, provocando una discusión entre ellas. Clarita se suma al almuerzo con Barranco y Patricia; le informa que Venancio acusó a Onofre de ser un asesino; Patricia lo niega asumiendo que Venancio solo está celoso.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.sub-title: Episodio 18: ¡Ana no es boba y suma!
programme.desc: Marilda se retira del edificio en ascensor antes de llegar a contarle a Ana acerca de la infidelidad de Cristóbal. Ana le pregunta a Guillermo acerca del secreto de Marilda, Cristóbal no permite que se lo cuente, pero Guillermo arregla para ir al colegio al día siguiente con la excusa del perro que van a adoptar. Carlitos sorprende a su hermana Patricia llorando, esta le cuenta que vio a Pedrote besándose con Purita. Pedrote cuenta a su mamá Lázara que está celoso de Patricia (piensa que tiene algo con Barranco). Patricia le cuenta a Nancy que Barranco la piropea, Nancy lo prefiere antes que a Pedrote para su hija.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Carlos Enrique, luego de buscar como loco a Nancy, la encuentra en el estacionamiento abrazada a Beltrán. Cuando Nancy y Carlos Enrique regresan a su apartamento se encuentran en el pasillo a Lázara, Pedrote y Patricia. Nancy enfurece cuando Carlos Enrique le dice que debe llamar a su padre para avisarle que está bien porque eso implica que Mireya se enteró que estuvo desaparecida. A todo esto Rafucho y Clarita aclaran sus diferencias y cuando regresa Beltrán los encuentra tomando un trago. Al día siguiente Cristóbal impide que Marilda lleve a sus hijos a la escuela y así evita que ella le cuente a Ana sobre la recaída que tuvieron.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Fabián está viendo por la ventana las escenas de amor de Armando y Finita. Se va pero se siente mal y Blanca sale a auxiliarlo Botero se siente mal - no habla. Blanca trata de ayudarlo pero al final lo deja irse Finita trata de convencer a Armando de que no se vaya pero el no se deja convencer y se va. Carolina va donde Juan Diego y comienza a perseguirlo para besarlo. Llega Yubiri y el le tapa la boca a Carolina y la esconde. Cuando se va Yubiri Carolina lo insulta.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Fabián no le habla a Finita - solamente la ve. Ella trata de inventar cosas pero el no le habla. Le pasa una libreta y un lápiz para que escriba - el escribe y se levanta y se va. Ella lee y se horroriza con lo que le escribió pero le da la razón. En la casa de Atanasio están despidiendo con una cena a Armando por su viaje. En casa de Briggite están hablando de Finita y los cuernos que le montó a Botero. Briggite y Dionisia están de acuerdo pero Carolina no.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker y todos los del grupo salen para saludar a Yubiri y Solymar. Lolita y Briggite están perdidas en el canal 4. Se aparece Daniel Zarcos y se despiden. Briggite le dice que tiene un sofá en su casa que es famosísimo. Ana y Pastor están caminando por un centro comercial muy enamorados. Pastor le dice a Ana que no sabe que hacer con Mauricio. Ella le dice que tienen que hablar con él antes que otra persona se lo diga. Pastor y Gisela están en el mismo centro comercial.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Graciela y Atanasio tienen una gran discusión. Atanasio quiere volver con Graciela pero esta piensa que el está casado y que no quiere nada con él. Junior llega a felicitarlos de nuevo pero Atanasio se va furioso. Gisela se muere de la risa cuando ve a Briggite tirada en el suelo abrazada al afiche de Luis Miguel. En el gato enmochilao están todos los muchachos del grupo y llega Palma diciéndoles que tienen que ir a la mañana bien temprano a firmar los CDs.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: A las afueras del estudio de grabación Yubiri se pelea con las fans de Wilker al mostrarse sorprendida por el hecho de que este se convirtió en un cantante famoso y cotizado - Yelitza rivaliza con Yubiri por la atención de Wilker mientras este hace una excepción en la rutina de su seguridad para permitirle a Yuribi el paso integrándola así a su nueva vida de gran estrella como su reconocida novia. En la agencia de publicidad - Mauricio conversa con Pastor quien esperando ser despedido.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: El doctor llama a Magdalena y le confirma que la junta consultiva ha decidido entregarle la información que ella pidió. Gabriel le ofrece acompañarla a buscar el sobre. Cuando llegan a la clínica, el doctor plantea que hay un inconveniente, y Agustín aparece, para explicar que a él no le habían pedido su permiso, como padre legal de Rodrigo. El doctor resuelve en dejar que Agustín decida si se abre el sobre o no, y él no deja que Magdalena sepa la verdad. - Ella se va triste, junto a Gabriel, y él la consuela. Epi se infiltra en la casa de Julieta vestido de mujer, haciéndose pasar por amiga de Ana Belén. Allí logra conseguir un cuaderno de Julieta, y luego se da a la fuga, dejando inclusive un zapato, el que luego Ana Belén sospecha que es de Valentina.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Gina provoca a Clemencia para que le diga la verdad sobre Luis Francisco Vilarte, acusándola de que eran amantes. Le pregunta sobre las cartas que guardaba de él, pero Clemencia no le dice nada, en cambio la golpea y Gina reacciona fuerte contra ella. Más tarde, Gina le cuenta a su padre Augusto sobre esto, y lo intenta hacer recapacitar sobre la infidelidad de Clemencia. Augusto se niega a escuchar sus palabras y le dice que ella no es lo suficientemente madura como para esos temas.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Amada le pide a Germán que mate a Enzo y a Milagros. Germán acepta y va a comentarle a Willy, pero él no acepta la idea de matar a nadie. Eulalia los encuentra y le pregunta a Germán por los teléfonos. Él le miente diciéndole que los tenía porque los estaba arreglando, pero Eulalia no le cree. German se va con Willy y Eulalia los sigue con un taxi. Luego Germán lo intenta convencer de nuevo, pero Willy no acepta y Germán le dice que se retire porque él sí va a cometer el crimen.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Germán ha secuestrado a Enzo y Milagros y los piensa matar pero su madre Eulalia trata de impedirlo. Enzo y Germán forcejean y se dispara la pistola de Germán y como resultado sale herida Eulalia. Germán luego de un tiempo desiste de su intención y se da a la fuga entonces Enzo y Milagros llevan a Eulalia al hospital y alegan que estaba en la calle. Clemencia sospecha de que alguien les quiere hacer daño a ella y a su familia y contrata al policía Braulio para custodie a su hija Gina.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Eulalia está internada y su hijo Germán la acompaña, éste le promete cambiar ya que Enzo no lo manda preso a Germán por lo del secuestro… Germán también le cuenta a Eulalia que él habló con su padre Artemio Asola quien le pidió a Germán una razón para no morirse y sentirse orgulloso de su hijo. Eulalia le oculta a Germán que tiene una grave enfermedad, le dice que sólo tiene diabetes; pero no es así tiene una enfermedad que le contagió su marido, por estar con mujeres de la calle.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Clemencia felicita a Milagros por el comercial que hizo, le dice que se tome libre el resto del día, y le dice que cada vez se parece más a lo que le hubiera gustado que fuera su hija perdida. Clemencia va a ver a Amada Vilarte y la amenaza con un arma por haber mandado a secuestrar a su hijo Enzo, y si Amada se mete con la familia de Clemencia, esta es capaz de matarla; pero entra Enzo y ve la situación. Amada se hace la víctima diciéndole a Enzo que su mamá compró la hipoteca de su casa.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín es extraditado tras las amenazas de muerte hacia Ricardo. Elizabeth, sumida en el dolor por la muerte de Celia, decide mudarse con su padre pese a la presencia de Katiuska, pero sufre una preocupante hemorragia nasal. Por otro lado, María del Pilar asegura que su hijo es de Marcelo ante la presión de Gustavo. Mientras Marcelo busca el divorcio de Graciela, Misael continúa profesando su amor por Manuela en medio de tensiones familiares y planes de venganza.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo regresa a la casa Tariffi, rompe con Katiuska y reafirma su amor por Manuela. Mientras Katiuska conspira contra los hijos de Ricardo y busca ayuda de criminales, Gustavo es hospitalizado por su grave estado de intoxicación. Marcelo es engañado por María del Pilar sobre un falso embarazo y Elizabeth oculta síntomas de una enfermedad. Finalmente, Ricardo lee una emotiva carta de Celia que lo insta a cuidar de sus hijos y a unirse definitivamente con Manuela.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo lee una carta de Celia pidiéndole casarse con Manuela y cuidar a sus hijos. Katiuska contrata a Renato para eliminar a Manuela. Se descubre que el testamento de la Nona es válido y que Katiuska robó el original, quedando fuera de la herencia junto a Hortensia. Elizabeth asiste al médico y se confirma que su salud no es grave. Finalmente, Ricardo ve un video que prueba la traición de Katiuska y la expulsa de su casa, mientras María del Pilar confiesa que no está embarazada.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo cancela su boda con Katiuska tras descubrir que robó el testamento. Katiuska ordena el secuestro de Ricardito durante su bautizo; Carrero arrebata al bebé y Laura Valentina es detenida por sospechas. Mientras Katiuska intenta culpar a Misael, Ricardo consuela a Manuela y le propone matrimonio nuevamente para cumplir la última voluntad de Celia.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Tras la desaparición de Ricardito, robado por Carrero, Manuela y Ricardo viven una pesadilla. Katiuska finge ayudar pero planea vengarse al saber que Ricardo aún ama a Manuela. Renato planta pruebas contra Manuela para incriminarla, mientras Elizabeth oculta una grave enfermedad que deteriora su salud. Entre sospechas de complicidad y detenciones injustas, la familia Tariffi enfrenta el caos mientras Carrero busca cobrar un rescate y su esposa pide devolver al niño por temor.

programme.title: Episodio 99
programme.desc: Los delincuentes liberan a Leticia tras el secuestro. Eustoquio se roba los documentos del Hato de Perijá del despacho de Rivero. Adolfo botará a Vilma de la empresa al descubrir que ordenó el secuestro. Erasto humilla a Natalia, ya completamente borracho, obligándola a desnudarse y bailar, y le habla a Natalia como si fuera Consuelo, revelando su obsesión. Eustoquio visita a Consuelo exigiendo su parte de la herencia como hijo de Erasto. Marisela bebe con Isaías. Alejandro sorprende a Rosa al regresar y le confiesa todo su amor.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro abraza a Rosa confesándole su amor, mientras Rosalía los espia y jura vengarse. Adolfo despide oficialmente a Vilma frente a Salvador. Eustoquio cuenta a Arminda haber robado los documentos. Rivero descubre el robo y avisa a Erasto, quien acusa a Alejandro inmediatamente. Marisela se desahoga con Rosa confesándole su soledad. Consuelo y Blanca planifican estrategias contra Erasto. Carmen Rosa le pide a Rosa devolver la hacienda. Natalia advierte a Alejandro que Erasto lo acusó del robo. Erasto entra furioso en la oficina de Adolfo buscando a Alejandro.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Natalia advierte a Alejandro que Erasto lo acusó del robo y le aconseja cuidarse. Isaías y Marisela se prometen abandonar el alcohol pero rompen su promesa. Consuelo cuenta a Leticia el amor incestuoso que Erasto siente por ella. Blanca confronta a Rosa con la verdad sobre su nacimiento, pero ella se niega a creer. Rosalía enfrenta a Rosa preguntando por el beso con Alejandro; Rosa confiesa que el hijo es de Alejandro y Rosalía la ataca golpeándola hasta hacerla caer. Carlos interviene a defender a Rosa, mientras Erasto enfrenta directamente a Alejandro.

programme.desc: Consuelo enfrenta a Rosalía en casa de los Alamo amenazándola; Marisela y Rosalía la insultan y la corren. Rosa inventa malestar para no dormir con Junior. Erasto golpea a Natalia al llegar borracho y celoso. Junior ruega a Rosa dormir juntos. Carmen Rosa recibe a Consuelo confundiéndola con Chencha y le aconseja: con regalos no se gana, sino con el corazón.

Al día siguiente Cristóbal impide que Marilda lleve a sus hijos a la escuela y así evita que ella le cuente a Ana sobre la recaída que tuvieron.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: A las afueras del estudio de grabación Yubiri se pelea con las fans de Wilker al mostrarse sorprendida por el hecho de que este se convirtió en un cantante famoso y cotizado - Yelitza rivaliza con Yubiri por la atención de Wilker mientras este hace una excepción en la rutina de su seguridad para permitirle a Yuribi el paso integrándola así a su nueva vida de gran estrella como su reconocida novia. En la agencia de publicidad - Mauricio conversa con Pastor quien esperando ser despedido.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín decide darle el divorcio a Magdalena, y la tenencia de Rodrigo, pero a cambio de eso quiere quedarse con la galería de arte. Ésta fue la herencia del padre de Magdalena para ella, por lo que tiene mucho valor en su vida. Gabriel León encontró a Julieta, y planea acercarse a ella. Sus últimos estudios médicos no tuvieron un diagnóstico favorable, y no le queda mucho tiempo. Julieta está a punto de enterarse de la verdad, de parte de Valentina, pero su madre, Ana Belén llega a casa de Valentina. Anteriormente no quiso escuchar a su papá, Efraín. Nayarí se encuentra preparando los carnavales. Antonio consiguió trabajo junto a Agustín, en la galería de arte. Ambos creen que tendrán una buena relación, ya que a ninguno de ellos les cae bien Gabriel León.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Tras la desaparición de Ricardito, robado por Carrero, Manuela y Ricardo viven una pesadilla. Katiuska finge ayudar pero planea vengarse al saber que Ricardo aún ama a Manuela. Renato planta pruebas contra Manuela para incriminarla, mientras Elizabeth oculta una grave enfermedad que deteriora su salud. Entre sospechas de complicidad y detenciones injustas, la familia Tariffi enfrenta el caos mientras Carrero busca cobrar un rescate y su esposa pide devolver al niño por temor.

programme.title: Episodio 103
programme.desc: Consuelo enfrenta a Rosalía en casa de los Alamo amenazándola; Marisela y Rosalía la insultan y la corren. Rosa inventa malestar para no dormir con Junior. Erasto confirma que Natalia está con José Luis. Marisela reclama a Alejandro defender a Consuelo. Adolfo enfrenta a Isaías en la tienda acusándolo de amante de Marisela. Erasto golpea a Natalia al llegar borracho y celoso. Junior ruega a Rosa dormir juntos. Carmen Rosa recibe a Consuelo confundiéndola con Chencha y le aconseja: con regalos no se gana, sino con el corazón.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Enzo va a buscar a Milagros a su departamento y en los pasillos se encuentra con Benito, le dice que es vecino de ella y de Luisita… en ese momento se escuchan gritos de Milagros pidiendo auxilio, ya que Artemio Ansola se había desmayado, éste había entrado a la casa de Olga para decirle toda la verdad sobre la hija perdida de Clemencia Talamonti. Enzo y Milagros lo llevan al hospital, donde descubren que Artemio es el esposo de Eulalia, entonces Enzo y Milagros tratan de hablar con Eulalia.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.sub-title: Episodio 20: La vida por un perro
programme.desc: Venancio encuentra a Lázara con Pablo Barranco y éste como es de esperar le hace un escándalo por celos. Sin darse cuenta que Carlos Enrique es testigo de este escándalo escucha toda la discusión de Venancio y Lázara. Allí Carlos Enrique escucha de un tal Pablo y empieza a tener un ataque de celos por Lázara, lo cual lo confunde porque debería estar celoso de su esposa Nancy, pero lejos de ello se enceguece y le pide explicaciones a Lázara sobre Pablo. Cuando Lázara creía que era imposible el romance con Carlos Enrique era imposible por estar casado, éste se presenta pidiéndole explicaciones del tal Pablo. Allí ella se da cuenta que no es ella sola quien está enamorada.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Tras un año de separación y sintiéndose alertada del regreso de Armando a Venezuela Finita visita su casa al buscar retomar su antiguo romance ahora avalada con el derecho de ser una mujer divorciada - Finita observa con horror la realización de su mas nefasta pesadilla al encontrarse con Natalia quien se presenta ante ella como la novia de Armando. en el local de persianas Botero se autocompadece de su situación como hombre y empleador tras haber perdido a Wilker como su empleado.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Julieta no quiere hablar con Valentina ni con su madre, está muy enojada y no confía en nadie, siente que todos le ocultan cosas. Ana Belén tiene miedo que Valentina le cuente la verdad a Julieta y se haga pasar por victima en vez de la mujer ambiciosa que era cuando le alquilo el vientre. Magdalena y Agustín discuten por la galería de arte y por el hijo que tienen. Agustín chantajea a Magdalena con la tenencia de Rodrigo a cambio de la galería que le pertenece a ella por ser una herencia familiar. Marilyn se imagina a Ricardo como un hombre perfecto. Valentina habla con Efraín y le cuenta que estuvo a punto de decirle toda la verdad a Julieta pero que llego Ana Belén y no lo pudo hacer.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo intenta rescatar a Ricardito mientras enfrenta la enfermedad de Elizabeth, quien necesita una biopsia medular. Katiuska es descubierta visitando a una bruja y abandona la casa de los Tariffi tras ser confrontada. En paralelo, Marcelo y Graciela se divorcian, mientras María del Pilar celebra el suceso. La policía identifica a Carrero como el secuestrador, y Ricardo se dispone a pagar el rescate personalmente, temiendo por su vida y encargando el cuidado de sus hijos a Manuela.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Clemencia promete renunciar a su venganza por su amor a Augusto. Augusto se siente culpable de haberla engañado con María Gracia y espera que su historia con ella termine así de rápido como empezó. Artemio Ansola está internado en el hospital que trabaja Augusto, en grave estado debido a la enfermedad que padece. Artemio sabe que pronto va a morir y no quiere llevarse consigo un gran secreto. Él sabe que fue lo que pasó con la hija perdida de Clemencia.

programme.title: Cosmic Conspiracy
programme.desc: There is a conspiracy to rule the world, but the truth is far stranger than fiction. Reality isn't what it seems. With UFO sightings and Alien Abductions on the rise, now is the time to awaken, and realize the biggest conspiracy of them all.

programme.title: Assimilate (aka Replicate)
programme.desc: Best friends Zach (Joel Courtney, THE KISSING BOOTH), Randy (Calum Worthy), and Kayla (Andi Matichak, HALLOWEEN) discover that their neighbors are being killed and replaced by perfect copies of their victims. Their only chance to survive is to covertly record the invasion in a desperate attempt to warn the world.

programme.title: Titan
programme.desc: Titan, Saturn's largest moon, is the main stage of the Mission Cronos. Orpheus, one of the astronauts who has descended to its surface, is searching for organic life forms. This is his story.

programme.title: Bravestorm
programme.desc: In the year 2050 mankind is extinct. The last survivors travel back in time to stop the invader, the Killgis, in a battle of giant robots.

programme.title: Final Voyage
programme.desc: Two men on the run encounter an old abandoned spaceship in the desert. They escape their pursuers into space and set off in search of a new home.

programme.title: Tangent Room
programme.desc: Trapped in a room with no escape, four brilliant minds race against time to prevent a cosmic collapse of the universe.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Janis, a child Cello prodigy, has struggled in her adult life with a split personality disorder and has willingly yielded to the control of her husband/therapist who, with the excuse of striving for her cure, has manipulated her all along through medication and psychological torture. He keeps her virtually imprisoned at his home in an isolated island where she spends her life fighting a never-ending battle inside her multiple personalities.

programme.title: Open Windows
programme.desc: A jilted fan soon finds himself pulled into a deadly game of cat-and-mouse after he accepts the opportunity to spy on his favorite actress via his laptop.

programme.title: Police Story: Lockdown
programme.desc: The highly-anticipated fifth installment of the Police Story franchise, starring Jackie Chan in a story of family ties, betrayal, and revenge.

programme.title: Robot Overlords
programme.desc: Earth has been conquered by robots from a distant galaxy. Survivors are confined to their houses and must wear electronic implants, risking incineration by robot sentries if they venture outside.

programme.title: Run Baby Run
programme.desc: Diana, deaf from birth, begins her training in an idyllic rural landscape, until she comes across a mysterious runner. Hidden behind the darkness of the hood of his sweatshirt, the runner and Diana begin a small running competition that degenerates into a desperate battle for survival. Diana will have to use all her resources, wit, and willpower to survive the violent attack of her pursuer.

programme.title: Secrets
programme.desc: After her mother's passing, Sammy, a resilient single mother, grapples with the looming threat of a breakdown while keeping her mysterious past hidden. Ava, Sammy's daughter, has hidden a desire to uncover the identity of her father, sensing his significant influence on her identity. The journey to bury her grandmother becomes Ava's chance to delve into her origins, but her exploration uncovers more than she intended to reveal.

programme.title: St. Agatha
programme.desc: A pregnant con woman on the run seeks refuge in a desolate convent, only to be met with an unsettling and horrendous evil waiting on the other side.

programme.title: Terrifier
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to the timid town of Miles County where he targets a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween night.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.

programme.title: The Golem
programme.desc: A mystical woman must save her village from invaders, but the entity she conjures to protect them is a far greater evil.

programme.title: The Lingering
programme.desc: When Dawa was a child, he and his mother were tormented by a strange presence in their house causing them to spend a fearful night hiding in the basement. Years later, after his mother’s death, Dawa is forced to return, once again facing the presence that once tortured him as a child. Is it a ghost or is there something more earthly to explain the strange occurrences?

programme.title: Wind Walkers
programme.desc: With one of their own missing, a group of friends travel to the remote Florida everglades where they discover that an ancient, malevolent curse is tracking them.

programme.title: Bad Milo
programme.desc: A man learns that his unusual stomach pains are being caused by a demon living in his intestines.

programme.title: Let The Right One In
programme.desc: Oskar, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Eli, a beautiful but peculiar girl.

programme.title: Kiss Of The Damned
programme.desc: A blossoming romance between a vampire and a human is endangered by an unexpected visit.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: After Earth has suffered an alien invasion a journalist escort an American tourist through an infected zone.

programme.title: Shark Girl
programme.desc: When a beautiful young influencer survives a mysterious shark attack, she becomes a monstrous apex predator, hunting and feeding in sunny Venice beach, California.

programme.title: The Golem
programme.desc: A mystical woman must save her village from invaders, but the entity she conjures to protect them is a far greater evil.

programme.title: Vanishing on 7th Street
programme.desc: A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.

programme.title: Uncaged
programme.desc: After finding a gruesomely slaughtered family just outside Amsterdam, the police calls veterinarian Lizzy for help. She finds herself leading the city-wide hunt for a monstrous lion terrorizing the Dutch capital in this grisly adventure.

programme.title: SPLINTER
programme.desc: Trapped in a gas station by a parasite, a couple and an escaped convict must find a way to survive.

programme.title: Monsters in the Closet
programme.desc: A horror's author's stories come to life when read out loud.

programme.title: Mermaid Down
programme.desc: A mermaid is ripped from the Pacific, her tail is chopped off and she's thrown into a mental home where no one believes she is a mermaid.

programme.title: Impossible Monsters
programme.desc: Dr. Rich Freeman (Tony Award winner Santino Fontana), an ambitious and well-liked psychology professor, pursues a sleep study with a focus on nightmares, dreams, and sleep paralysis -- the success of which would result in a lucrative grant. As the line between dreams and reality blur, a member of the study is murdered, and everything begins to unravel, leaving Rich fighting to make things right.

programme.title: The Love Witch
programme.desc: A modern-day witch uses spells and magic to get men to fall in love with her, in a tribute to 1960s Technicolor thrillers.

programme.title: The Sacrament
programme.desc: A mysterious rural utopia quickly becomes evident that this paradise may not be as it seems.

programme.title: The Truth About Emanuel
programme.desc: A troubled young woman becomes obsessed with her mysterious new neighbor, who bears a striking resemblance to the girl's dead mother.

programme.title: The War Between
programme.desc: April 1862, in the Arizona territory. During the opening months of the Civil War, two enemy soldiers must cooperate in order to survive being stranded in the Sonoran Desert.

programme.title: Vanishing on 7th Street
programme.desc: A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.

programme.title: V/H/S
programme.desc: A group of misfits acquire a rare tape with terrifying footage and are confronted with a dead body.

programme.title: V/H/S 2
programme.desc: Mysterious VHS tapes with horrific contents are found in a missing student's abandoned house.

programme.title: Violet & Daisy
programme.desc: Two teenage assassins accept what they think will be a quick-and-easy job, until an unexpected target throws them off their plan.

programme.title: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
programme.desc: Two sisters live in isolation with their deranged uncle following the deaths of the rest of their family. When a cousin comes to visit, family secrets and scandals unravel. Based on the beloved Shirley Jackson novel.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.
